author: Mark Atwood
text: Closing as canonical-template propagation deferred. Verified via rg in jmap-mail-server: the canonical sibling carries the SAME uncentralized BackendSetError pattern across mdn.rs, vacation.rs (3 sites), mailbox.rs, email.rs, sieve.rs, submission.rs, identity.rs — confirming this is a workspace-wide pattern, not a calendars-local divergence. The bead body explicitly directs 'Verify whether mail-server centralized this before reshaping here' — mail-server has not centralized it. Per workspace AGENTS.md cookie-cutter rule, the consolidation must land in the canonical first then propagate to every extension-server sibling in the same pass. Pairs with bd:JMAP-ic0j.36, .51, .35 in the same canonical-propagation-deferred family. If a future workspace-wide map_backend_set_error helper consolidation epic is filed, this finding is its evidence baseline.
